_doc: Public keys whose signature makes an embedded template (kgt.py, KGT2) loadable. ECDSA P-256, uncompressed point in hex; fpr = first 8 bytes of SHA-256 over the point. The private key is kept by the maintainer and is never in the repository.

keys.use: release: signs the templates of the product files in this repository; the private key exists only inside a hardware key
